fullDescription: A vibrant Retro 80s Pastel Terminal design system combining vaporwave aesthetics with brutalist interface elements. Features a soft lavender (#e8d5f2) and peachy-pink (#ffd89b) color palette, pixel-perfect typography (VT323, Press Start 2P), and tactile 3D depth through hard-edged stacked shadows. Suitable for retro gaming platforms, creative agencies, fintech dashboards with a nostalgic twist, or developer-centric landing pages. Includes scanline overlays, flicker animations, and high-contrast brutalist card structures.
prompt:
## Resumo
A nostalgic 80s terminal UI utilizing pastel tones, pixel-art fonts, and sharp brutalist shapes. The system relies on a 'layered' look using multi-directional hard shadows to create depth without using gradients or rounded corners.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design with a soft lavender (#e8d5f2) background and a persistent scanline overlay (linear-gradient(rgba(232, 213, 242, 0) 50%, rgba(170, 230, 207, 0.2) 50%) at 4px intervals). Use two primary fonts: 'Press Start 2P' for small labels and main titles, and 'VT323' for all other text. All UI elements must have a border-radius of 0px. Borders should be 2px or 4px thick in #4a3b52. Implement a 3D effect using stacked shadows: a dark layer (#4a3b52) at 4px and a secondary warm coral layer (#ffb8a1) at 8px. Use 'pixelarticons' for all iconography. Text should be dark purple (#4a3b52). Interactive elements should have a click-down animation that translates Y by 4px and reduces shadow depth.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Navigation Bar
A full-width top bar with a logo comprised of a nested box (40x40px #ffd89b border, inner #e8d5f2 box) with a computer pixel icon. Navigation links should be uppercase, wrapped in brackets like '[ LINK_NAME ]', using VT323 size 24px. Include a small 'BOOT_STATION' CTA button in the corner with a 2px border and #ffb8a1 shadow.

### Hero Section
Centrally aligned content. Features a large heading using 'Press Start 2P' with a subtle flicker animation. Below the heading, a high-contrast subtitle in VT323 (32px, bold). Buttons are large (80px height), one filled with #ffd89b and the other outlined with a 4px #ffb8a1 border. Include large pixel sun or cloud icons above the title as decorative accents.

### Feature Grid
A 3-column grid of 'Brutalist Cards'. Each card has a 4px border (#4a3b52), #ffd89b background, and a secondary shadow of #ffb8a1 offset by 8px. One card should be a 'Terminal Input' style using a mint green (#a8e6cf) background with a bottom-border-only text input and a high-contrast action button inside.

### Status Sidebars
Fixed decorative elements on the left and right edges. Left: Vertical text labels rotated 90 degrees showing 'TEMP', 'LOAD', and 'ZONE' metrics in VT323 font. Right: A vertical line indicator with pixel arrows at top and bottom, set at 40% opacity.

### Footer
A simple footer separated by a 4px #ffb8a1 top border. Contains a row of pixel-style social icons (30px size) and a copyright line with a version number (e.g., VER: 80.S.WAVE) in small pixel font.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Brutalist Active Button — A tactile button with a simulated 3D press effect.
Background color #ffd89b, border 2px solid #4a3b52, box-shadow: 0 6px 0 0 #ffb8a1. On active/click state: transform: translateY(4px); box-shadow: 0 2px 0 0 #ffb8a1. Use 'Press Start 2P' font at 10px-14px for text.

### Terminal Scanline Overlay — A fullscreen CRT-style scanline effect.
A fixed div covering the entire viewport. Background is a repeating linear gradient of transparent and 20% opacity mint green (#a8e6cf) every 4px. Set z-index to 50 but ensure 'pointer-events: none' so user interaction is not blocked.

### Double-Shadow Card — Cards that appear to pop off the page with layered depth.
Border 4px solid #4a3b52. Background #ffd89b. Primary shadow: 4px 4px 0 0 #4a3b52. Secondary shadow: 8px 8px 0 0 #ffb8a1. Ensure the shadows are crisp with no blur (spread 0, blur 0).

## Notas Especiais
MUST: Maintain 0px border-radius on everything. MUST: Use only hex #4a3b52 for borders and primary text for high readability. MUST: Ensure the scanline overlay is 'pointer-events: none'. DO NOT: Use modern rounded corners, blurred shadows, or smooth gradients. DO NOT: Mix sans-serif fonts into the layout.

style.description: The style is defined by a 'soft-brutalist' approach. Typography uses VT323 for body/mono text and Press Start 2P for headings. Colors are pastel but high-contrast: Lavender (#e8d5f2) background, Peachy-Pink (#ffd89b) accents, Mint (#a8e6cf) highlights, and Deep Purple (#4a3b52) for text and borders. Animations include CRT flicker and scanline overlays to simulate an old computer monitor.
